metadata.title: Elite Personal Training | Personal Coaching in Birmingham
metadata.description: Personalised coaching for those who want direct access and real accountability. Book your free intro.

source.analysis_summary: The existing site is a generic Wix template with no clear CTA, no social proof above the fold, and weak mobile layout. The business itself is a premium one-to-one coaching studio with strong client outcomes. The opportunity is to make the site feel as credible and direct as the coaching experience is.

design_doctrine.emotional_positioning: Confident, calm, and premium — a coach who is fully in your corner, not a gym that shouts at you.
design_doctrine.trust_strategy: Lead with the coach's face and real client outcomes. Use specific numbers (years, clients, ratings) instead of vague claims. Show the actual training environment rather than generic stock gym shots.
design_doctrine.hero_strategy: The hero promises direct access and accountability. Primary CTA books a free intro. Secondary CTA explains the process. The headline is outcome-focused, not service-focused.
design_doctrine.conversion_strategy: Move the visitor from 'I want results' to 'I will book a free intro' in one scroll. Every section reduces the friction of that decision.
design_doctrine.objection_reduction_strategy: Free intro removes cost risk. Process section explains what happens. Testimonials prove results. About section establishes experience and credibility.
design_doctrine.local_credibility_strategy: Show the coach, the space, and the location. Use real training photography. Mention years in the area and the kind of clients served.
design_doctrine.proof_and_reassurance_strategy: Client count, years of experience, average rating, goal achievement rate, and three detailed testimonials with outcomes.

components.description: Sticky header with logo, nav links, phone, and primary CTA.
Two-column dark hero with large editorial type left and full-bleed image right. Primary + secondary CTA buttons.
Horizontal row of 4 stat blocks with large number + short label. Thin dividers between.
Three-column card grid with icon, title, body, link. Cards have subtle border and hover lift.
Horizontal three-step row with numbered steps in accent colour. Connected by thin line.
Two-column with image left and credential list right. Accent vertical rule on left edge of text column.
Three card grid. Each card: circular avatar, blockquote text, name + transformation stat in accent.
Full-width accent colour band. Centred headline + body + single large CTA button (white on accent).
Multi-column footer with logo, links, contact details, and legal links.

copy.text: Personalised coaching for those who want direct access and real accountability.
Weekly sessions, a personalised plan, and a coach who's fully in your corner.
Full programming and check-ins wherever you train. No gym required.
Practical eating plans that fit your life — not a crash diet.
We talk about your goals, your history, and whether we're the right fit.
I build a training and nutrition plan around your schedule and goals.
Weekly check-ins, regular plan updates, real progress — no guesswork.
Coaching built on results, not promises
I've been in the industry for 8 years. I've worked with everyone from beginners to competitive athletes. I take on a small number of clients so I can give each one my full attention.
Lost 14kg in 4 months and didn't have to give up a social life. Best investment I've made in myself.
Finally understood what I was doing wrong in the gym. Six months later I'm stronger than I've ever been.
Online coaching was the only thing that fit around my schedule. Genuinely life-changing.
Book your free 30-minute intro call. No pressure, no commitment.
© 2026 Elite Personal Training. All rights reserved.
